title: Hide Me from the Wicked

questions.question: Hear my voice, O God, in my complaint; preserve my life from dread of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 64:1 (ESV): "Hear my voice, O God, in my complaint; preserve my life from dread of the enemy."

questions.question: Hide me from the secret plots of the wicked, from the throng of whom?
Who whet their tongues like swords, who aim bitter words like what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 64:3 (ESV): "...who aim bitter words like arrows,"

questions.question: They shoot from ambush at the blameless, shooting at him suddenly and without what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 64:4 (ESV): "shooting at him suddenly and without fear."

questions.question: They hold fast to their evil purpose; they talk of laying snares secretly, thinking, "Who can what?"
They search out injustice, saying, "We have accomplished a diligent what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 64:6 (ESV): "...saying, 'We have accomplished a diligent search.'"

questions.question: But God shoots his arrow at them; they are wounded how?
questions.explanation: Psalm 64:7 (ESV): "But God shoots his arrow at them; they are wounded suddenly."

questions.question: They are brought to ruin, with their own tongues turned against whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 64:8 (ESV): "They are brought to ruin, with their own tongues turned against them;"

questions.question: All who see them will wag their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 64:8 (ESV): "all who see them will wag their heads."

questions.question: Then all mankind fears; they tell what God has brought about and ponder what he has what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 64:9 (ESV): "...and ponder what he has done."

questions.question: Let the righteous one rejoice in the Lord and take refuge in whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 64:10 (ESV): "Let the righteous one rejoice in the Lord and take refuge in him!"

questions.question: Let all the upright in heart do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 64:10 (ESV): "Let all the upright in heart exult!"

questions.question: For the inward mind and heart of a man are what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 64:6 (ESV): "For the inward mind and heart of a man are deep."

questions.question: Who aims bitter words like arrows?
questions.explanation: Referring to the wicked/evildoers/enemy described in verses 1-3.

questions.question: Who will shoot an arrow at them?
questions.explanation: Psalm 64:7 (ESV): "But God shoots his arrow at them;"

key_verse_text: Let the righteous one rejoice in the Lord and take refuge in him! Let all the upright in heart exult!
